big_case.notes: Independent read formed from the record before weighing the candidates' scores: roughly $6 billion in Madoff feeder-fund clawback claims, a first-impression Second Circuit reading of Chapter 15 and the section 546(e) safe harbor, repeat Supreme Court counsel on both sides and two amicus briefs. Real stakes for the cross-border insolvency bar, but a technical commercial dispute with little public salience; the Court denied at its first conference with no CVSG, no relist and no noted dissent (one recusal), treating it as routine.
